decisions.reason: The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's core drainage know-how and its barrier-free strategy, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it with existing R&D.

The pump-assisted line reaches into pump technology, where the firm's absorptive capacity is thinner, and the follow-up pump-drain shower channel (F) suggests consolidation is possible, but the firm's continued learning and the renovation demand for it justify keeping it for now.
The tileable floor drain with grating sits squarely within the firm's established offer and is fully interpretable with its existing knowledge, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The newly launched pump-drain shower channel has its own page and draws on what the firm learned from the pump-assisted line, so it merits time to develop.
